observations: The candidate hash-binds Q/K/V projection and RoPE to DecoderBlock.scala, SHA-256 ec517051054fb006bd56e9012481f6b412cff3834ba98e4bfe66539b3cecf785; GQA mapping to QKVProjection.scala, SHA-256 3ca84ba8f25c4f151d9bba237fbf61f1c2ca64b572dc02a1e570e8649a546bc1; softmax to Softmax.scala, SHA-256 4f68287b82eab429fa5da62a9d8f3fd1a537f00ef42e364f411e7dd3537e94f2; output projection to Attention.scala, SHA-256 c3e8bfc0ab0c1c8d4421bb0fe03272f4ea420df3f0e710b6a3c4154843593a7e; and causal mask to Mask.scala, SHA-256 bfb70e48641d60c25100b8240d5fef461aa954847c5fe5777b7fbb5445fc0e0a. The corresponding supplied attention semantic and template source/interface checker results pass.
The stated GQA ratio is internally consistent: 4 query heads / 1 KV head = group size 4. The candidate binds head_dim=256, so query projection width is 4×256=1024, while hidden_size is 1152.

The supplied template_parameter_binding_check fails for both self_attention and gemma3_text_block because hidden_size=1152 does not equal num_q_heads×head_dim=1024. Both bindings are marked incomplete and the errors are repeated in unsupported_bindings. This is a current-stage legality blocker; the passing operator coverage and attention semantic expansion checks do not clear it.

The candidate marks KV cache as required=false/status=not_required and supplies a DecoderBlock.scala source hash, but no visible model evidence explains why cache behavior is unnecessary. The supplied model facts include causal attention and a 16-position streamed-token configuration; those facts do not by themselves prove caching is required, but the not-required classification cannot be accepted without an evidence-backed disposition.
Causal masking is required and bound to model_config.attention.causal=true and seq_len=16. Softmax and output projection are also marked required and covered.

The cross-layer trace reports numeric policy, board memory/runtime/deployment, and input-consistency facts present. Numeric bindings show 4-bit weights, 8-bit activations, and 32-bit accumulation; these do not resolve the attention shape legality issue. Candidate-bound lanes and array dimensions are not selected yet and are not this stage's blocker.

All required parameters are populated for the selected block wrapper and operators; the binding records report no missing parameters. The block wrapper and self-attention are marked incomplete only because of the reported shape relation.

The block wrapper binds hidden_size=1152, num_q_heads=4, num_kv_heads=1, head_dim=256, intermediate_size=6912, token_count=16, and max_seq_len=16. Self-attention binds the corresponding shape values and seq_len=16.

The reported arithmetic is correct for both entries: num_q_heads × head_dim is 1024, which differs from hidden_size by 128. These are two occurrences of the same predicate, not evidence of two distinct underlying shape conflicts.

The supplied named constraints and template source/interface records do not state that hidden_size must equal num_q_heads × head_dim. Source/interface checks pass and report complete constructor/metadata parameter coverage, but the summary does not expose source semantics establishing this particular equality as mandatory.

Accordingly, the arithmetic discrepancy is supported by the bound values, but classifying it as illegal is supported only if the checker’s equality predicate is an authoritative template/model invariant. That invariant is not independently evidenced in the supplied summary.

Numeric parameters are explicitly sourced from the numeric policy: weight_bits=4, activation-derived input/element/output widths=8, acc_bits=32, and integer_mode=true. Norm epsilon is bound from model_config.norm.eps as 1e-06.

lanes, compute_array_rows, and compute_array_cols are explicitly candidate-bound from the design-space, memory, and numeric inputs, with null values pending candidate selection. The stage gate policy assigns their concrete selection to Stage 4; this is not a missing-binding blocker here.

The listed template source/interface checks pass with source hashes, and operator coverage is 11/11. Attention semantic expansion and cross-layer trace checks also pass. The cross-layer trace shows the numeric, memory, runtime, deployment, and input-consistency constraints present.

The candidate checker results do not include a numeric_policy_check result or numeric_compare result. Numeric provenance is visible in the bindings, but this review does not claim those checkers passed; numerical comparison is not evidenced by the supplied artifact.

Coverage reports 11 required operators and 11 covered operators, with a block wrapper and no missing operators. The listed order maps as follows: rms_norm_input -> Norm.scala/norm; self_attention -> Attention.scala/attention; rms_norm_post_attention -> Norm.scala/norm; residual_add_1 -> Residual.scala/residual; rms_norm_pre_ffn -> Norm.scala/norm; mlp_gate_proj, mlp_up_proj, and mlp_down_proj -> FFN.scala/ffn; activation_mul -> Elementwise.scala/elementwise; rms_norm_post_ffn -> Norm.scala/norm; residual_add_2 -> Residual.scala/residual. The selected block wrapper is DecoderBlock.scala/decoder_block.

Required attention coverage is reported for QKV projection and RoPE in DecoderBlock.scala (SHA-256 ec517051054fb006bd56e9012481f6b412cff3834ba98e4bfe66539b3cecf785), GQA mapping in QKVProjection.scala (3ca84ba8f25c4f151d9bba237fbf61f1c2ca64b572dc02a1e570e8649a546bc1), softmax in Softmax.scala (4f68287b82eab429fa5da62a9d8f3fd1a537f00ef42e364f411e7dd3537e94f2), output projection in Attention.scala (c3e8bfc0ab0c1c8d4421bb0fe03272f4ea420df3f0e710b6a3c4154843593a7e), and causal mask in Mask.scala (bfb70e48641d60c25100b8240d5fef461aa954847c5fe5777b7fbb5445fc0e0a). KV cache is explicitly not required. GQA values are 4 query heads, 1 KV head, group size 4.

The supplied operator_sequence places residual_add_1 after rms_norm_post_attention and residual_add_2 after rms_norm_post_ffn, with the pre-FFN norm before the MLP operators. This confirms the listed sequence order; explicit residual operand/dataflow edges are not included in the supplied artifact, so this review does not claim to verify operand wiring.

The parameter bindings cite constraint.shape.model.hidden_size=1152, head_dim=256, and num_q_heads=4. Those represented values yield 1024 projected query dimensions, a 128-dimension discrepancy. The checker reports the same incompatibility for gemma3_text_block and self_attention. This supports the reported mismatch as currently bound, but the underlying model_config and field_evidence rows are not shown for an independent source-value comparison.

Other cited bindings include intermediate_size=6912, target_max_seq_len=16, num_kv_heads=1, and norm epsilon 1e-6. Numeric policy, board memory, runtime, deployment, and cross-layer consistency are present in the trace, which reports pass. No model-tail operators appear in the listed Transformer-block sequence.
